title: The Presentation in the Temple (Simeon's prophecy)
alt: In a pillared temple hall, Mary kneels at the altar table offering the Child to the aged Simeon, while Joseph and a crowd of onlookers gather round

title: The Flight into Egypt
alt: Mary, the Child in her arms, rides a donkey through a palm forest as Joseph strides ahead leading it, with a host of angels in the clouds above

title: Christ among the Doctors
alt: Under a great arch, the boy Jesus sits among the doctors of the Temple, who consult their books, while Mary and Joseph enter anxiously at the left

title: The Bearing of the Cross
alt: Christ, crowned with thorns, falls beneath the weight of the cross among soldiers and onlookers, while Mary and the holy women grieve at the lower left

title: The Crucifixion
alt: Christ hangs on the cross under the INRI title; Mary and the holy women grieve with Saint John on the left, soldiers with spears stand on the right, and Mary Magdalene kneels at the foot of the cross beside a skull

title: The Lamentation
alt: Beneath the cross, the dead body of Christ, just taken down, is held up by his disciples while Mary clasps her hands in grief, a woman cries out with raised arms, and Mary Magdalene bends to his feet; the crown of thorns lies on the ground

title: The Entombment
alt: Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus lay the body of Christ in the stone tomb, while Mary, Saint John and the holy women mourn behind, one with a jar of ointment; the crown of thorns lies in the grass

title: The Holy Family in Egypt
alt: Mary sits spinning and sewing beside the cradle with angels attending her, while Joseph works with an axe at a timber trough and child angels gather wood chips; God the Father and the dove look down from the clouds

title: The Holy Family with the Dragonfly
alt: Mary, her long hair loose, sits in a landscape holding the Christ Child to her cheek while Joseph sleeps beside her; the Father and the dove shine from the clouds above and a river town lies behind

title: The Virgin and Child with the Monkey
alt: Mary, a halo about her head, sits by a river holding the Christ Child, who has a small bird on his hand; a chained monkey crouches at her feet and a half-timbered house stands behind
